messages.text: Your order is marked as shipped, not delivered, so it isn’t eligible for a refund through this process yet. Cancelling the order or changing its delivery is outside the refund process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). You can ask for a person if you’d like.
What can I do to get a refund once it’s delivered?

Once the order is delivered, the cookware set must also be recorded as returned to the shop before you can request a refund. You’ll need to request it within 30 days of the recorded delivery time. The refund is the amount you paid for the item, excluding shipping (refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/window; refund-policy/v2/amount).

You can then ask me to start the refund request. It will need your confirmation on the proposal card and staff approval before it can be paid (refund-policy/v2/approval).
